scope: Account control across consumer, Household and Seller journeys. Normal flows and acceptance scenarios are proposed Etail business checks, not observed Amex screen walkthroughs or completed Etail features.

evidence_status_definition.documented: Official Amex material supports the core business task in the stated program; edge coverage and Etail delivery still require review.
evidence_status_definition.partial: Related public evidence exists, but role, market, exception or end-to-end coverage remains incomplete.
evidence_status_definition.gap: No reviewed source establishes the equivalent complete journey; cited sources are adjacent context only.

checks.journey: Confirm the responsible payer before granting access
checks.normal_flow: Choose the account and product; identify the responsible party, funder and person who may spend before presenting approval.
checks.exceptions: A payer, owner or manager may be a different person; a title change must not silently transfer existing obligations.
checks.issuing_handoff: The card request names the approved responsibility and funding arrangement.
checks.merchant_handoff: Seller acquiring responsibility remains distinct from commercial-card responsibility.
checks.etail_gap: The existing row needs a responsibility-change and pre-existing-obligation review, not only a role label.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A manager is replaced; past spending remains assigned to its original responsible party until an expressly approved change.

checks.journey: Delegate account management with an exact scope
checks.normal_flow: Review permitted tasks and information, invite the person and show when access becomes active.
checks.exceptions: Wrong invitee, rejected invitation, unavailable access level or conflicting owner instructions must remain visible.
checks.issuing_handoff: Management alone gives no card-issuance or spending permission.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant refund and payout permissions require their own selection.
checks.etail_gap: Define the complete invite/accept/revoke journey and resolve delegate-removal authority explicitly.
checks.acceptance_scenario: An invited reporting manager sees the selected account only and cannot add a card, pay out or extend their own powers.

checks.journey: Separate holding a card from administering an account
checks.normal_flow: Assign the holder's permitted card activity independently of management tasks.
checks.exceptions: A manager without a holder assignment cannot spend; a holder cannot appoint managers.
checks.issuing_handoff: Cardholder selection and issuance approval are separate steps.
checks.merchant_handoff: A Seller employee's card assignment does not grant merchant administration.
checks.etail_gap: The comparison must exercise both directions of the distinction, including a person who holds both roles.
checks.acceptance_scenario: One person receives only management access, another only a spending assignment; each is denied the other's actions.

checks.journey: Invite and enroll the right participant
checks.normal_flow: Choose the account and requested scope, send an invitation, verify the intended participant and record acceptance.
checks.exceptions: Wrong address, reused invitation, different sign-in and missing local approval require a safe correction path.
checks.issuing_handoff: The accepted person resumes the same card request.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant staff access must identify the approved Seller/location.
checks.etail_gap: Corporate enrollment is documented; equivalent end-to-end Household and Seller invitation rules need explicit review.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A second person opens an invitation intended for the first and cannot accept or see the account.

checks.journey: Handle unreceived, expired and withdrawn invitations
checks.normal_flow: Show invitation status; permit authorized resend or a fresh invitation while retaining the original history.
checks.exceptions: An expired, withdrawn or already accepted invitation cannot restore old rights.
checks.issuing_handoff: Resume a valid draft without creating another requested card.
checks.merchant_handoff: An obsolete merchant invitation cannot add a departed employee.
checks.etail_gap: Existing save/resume rows do not fully cover withdrawal, resend and wrong-recipient recovery.
checks.acceptance_scenario: Withdraw an invitation, resend a narrower one, then open both; only the current intended access can be accepted.

checks.journey: Distinguish company approval from card approval
checks.normal_flow: Complete requested details, obtain the applicable approval, submit and track the next responsible party.
checks.exceptions: Returned details, changed amount/holder, declined request and absent approver require a clear next action.
checks.issuing_handoff: Company or guardian permission is not an issued card or an issuer decision.
checks.merchant_handoff: A merchant manager cannot approve card liability merely by administering sales.
checks.etail_gap: Make approval independence, changed-request review and alternate-approver continuity explicit.
checks.acceptance_scenario: After approval, change the holder or permitted amount; require fresh approval before proceeding.

checks.journey: Delegate within the right business or location
checks.normal_flow: Select the business/location, review the person's permitted tasks and appoint only within the grantor's authority.
checks.exceptions: A regional or local role cannot silently expand to other businesses, countries or private Personal activity.
checks.issuing_handoff: Card-management scope follows the selected relationship.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant access follows the assigned Seller and locations.
checks.etail_gap: A global role label must not conceal different scopes or allow over-delegation.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A location administrator grants a colleague access; neither person gains a sibling location or the owner's Personal records.

checks.journey: Review everyone with access
checks.normal_flow: Review people, tasks, locations, effective dates and pending changes; investigate unexpected access.
checks.exceptions: The review can be stale or omit an unaccepted invitation; show its date and scope.
checks.issuing_handoff: Identify who may request, approve, issue, manage and spend.
checks.merchant_handoff: Include merchant reporting, dispute, bank-setting and payout permissions.
checks.etail_gap: Expand the people list to include pending invitations and distinct sensitive authorities.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A review lists one person's reporting access and another's payout access accurately, including pending removals.

checks.journey: Revoke a delegate completely
checks.normal_flow: Remove the specified authority, confirm its effective status and stop new access and future private deliveries.
checks.exceptions: Previously downloaded information cannot be recalled; unresolved work must be reassigned without restoring the delegate.
checks.issuing_handoff: Review outstanding drafts, approvals and card-management duties separately.
checks.merchant_handoff: Remove merchant permissions and scheduled report recipients.
checks.etail_gap: The broad revoke row does not prove removal from scheduled reports, exports, phone servicing or pending approvals.
checks.acceptance_scenario: Revoke a manager with a scheduled report and open old links; no new private content is delivered and another authorized person owns pending work.

checks.journey: Complete an employee's exit
checks.normal_flow: Review roles, assigned cards, pending applications, approvals, alerts, reports and expenses; cancel or reassign each responsibility.
checks.exceptions: A cancelled login may leave an active card; cancelling a card may leave reporting access, expenses or repayment work.
checks.issuing_handoff: Confirm card cancellation and keep late charges, refunds and open cases attributable.
checks.merchant_handoff: Transfer dispute deadlines and remove bank/payout powers without losing settlement work.
checks.etail_gap: The ninety-row catalog lacks one complete staff-exit checklist spanning cards, reports and remaining obligations.
checks.acceptance_scenario: An employee who is holder, approver and report recipient leaves; all three roles end while a later refund and existing dispute remain handled.

checks.journey: Explain spending limits and changes
checks.normal_flow: Review available funding and current use, set a permitted limit, explain its effective period and show the holder the result.
checks.exceptions: Existing use, tips/late charges, failed change and period boundaries need understandable handling.
checks.issuing_handoff: A limit does not create funding or guarantee every purchase is approved.
checks.merchant_handoff: Seller funds reserved for spending are not simultaneously available for payout.
checks.etail_gap: Explicitly depart from Amex's documented earlier-spend exclusion; Etail retains already-used amounts on edits.
checks.acceptance_scenario: After spending 80 of 100, changing the limit to 90 leaves 10 of that limit, without restoring the earlier 80.

checks.journey: Pause, resume, cancel and replace the correct card
checks.normal_flow: Identify the card and restriction, explain what changes, confirm the action and show remaining permitted activity.
checks.exceptions: A parent's/account restriction cannot be lifted by a holder; delayed activity and failed requests need a visible outcome.
checks.issuing_handoff: Cancellation differs from temporary restriction or replacement; history stays connected.
checks.merchant_handoff: Late merchant claims, refunds and settlements continue to be explained.
checks.etail_gap: Add scope, duration, failure and late-activity review; do not inherit automatic Amex unfreeze.
checks.acceptance_scenario: Freeze the account, then let a holder attempt to resume their card; spending stays blocked while a valid earlier purchase finishes.

checks.journey: Route useful alerts without expanding visibility
checks.normal_flow: Choose applicable events, recipients and channels; distinguish spending warnings, financial notices and security messages.
checks.exceptions: Wrong contact, failed delivery, revoked recipient and alert-only category controls must be handled explicitly.
checks.issuing_handoff: A category alert is not a purchase block or additional spending permission.
checks.merchant_handoff: A missed dispute alert cannot leave a case without an owner.
checks.etail_gap: Specify required versus optional messages, recipient scope and delivery-failure follow-up.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A category warning is delivered only to permitted recipients; an undelivered case alert still leaves the case in the responsible team's queue.

checks.journey: Keep each person's activity private
checks.normal_flow: Show the activity needed for the selected role and account, with clear holder attribution.
checks.exceptions: Shared membership or Household participation must not expose unrelated Personal or Seller history or funding totals.
checks.issuing_handoff: A holder sees their assignment and necessary remaining allocation.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant staff see only assigned Seller activity.
checks.etail_gap: Amex's account-total display is an explicit departure for Etail's narrower Household privacy.
checks.acceptance_scenario: An adult supplies a Household allowance; another participant sees that allowance but not the adult's Personal balance or unrelated purchases.

checks.journey: Apply the same visibility to statements and reports
checks.normal_flow: Select a period and account, review the permitted information, download or request an accessible copy.
checks.exceptions: Old links, archived periods, changed permissions and scheduled delivery require the same scope review.
checks.issuing_handoff: Holder documents cannot include another holder's private activity.
checks.merchant_handoff: Location reports and merchant statements remain within assigned access.
checks.etail_gap: Add post-revocation delivery and cross-location export review; existing download rows are broader.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A viewer's access ends before a scheduled statement is sent; no statement is delivered, and an authorized replacement recipient can obtain it.

checks.journey: Separate bill payment from bank-setting authority
checks.normal_flow: Review the obligation and payment source, confirm permitted payment, and treat adding/changing a source as a separate decision.
checks.exceptions: Wrong source, duplicate payment, returned payment or removed payer authority needs follow-up.
checks.issuing_handoff: Consumer, Seller and supervised products retain their distinct repayment meanings.
checks.merchant_handoff: Paying a card bill gives no right to change merchant settlement details or release payouts.
checks.etail_gap: Document exact delegation and payment-source consent; a minor must never acquire an independent Etail bill.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A payment delegate can make an approved repayment but cannot add a source, change a payout destination or move liability.

checks.journey: Complete merchant access enrollment without implying approval
checks.normal_flow: Identify the approved business and requested services, complete required verification and show available access.
checks.exceptions: Deferred verification and rejected information must show limited access and a next step.
checks.issuing_handoff: Merchant enrollment gives no commercial-card eligibility.
checks.merchant_handoff: Online access is distinct from merchant approval and settlement entitlement.
checks.etail_gap: Separate access enrollment, merchant service approval and card-product approval in the experience.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A partly enrolled merchant user can finish permitted setup but cannot view financial records or request a payout.

checks.journey: Assign location access and financial reporting
checks.normal_flow: Choose locations and permitted reports, confirm the scope and review it when staff duties change.
checks.exceptions: Adding/removing a profile location must not silently create or close a merchant relationship.
checks.issuing_handoff: Location reporting gives no authority to administer an owner's cards.
checks.merchant_handoff: Payments, statements, disputes and account settings are separate permissions.
checks.etail_gap: Expand location visibility into the complete permission review; avoid importing Flexible access as an Etail default.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A reporting user may download their location statement but cannot open another location or add dispute/bank-setting powers.

checks.journey: Review merchant bank changes and payout authority separately
checks.normal_flow: Select the affected business/destination, verify sensitive changes and obtain required approval before use.
checks.exceptions: Wrong location, stale approval, failed verification, changed destination or unavailable funds must stop the inappropriate action.
checks.issuing_handoff: Reserved backing for commercial cards remains unavailable for release.
checks.merchant_handoff: A destination change and a payout request have separate responsible actors and confirmations.
checks.etail_gap: Public portal guides do not establish every payout role; Etail needs an explicit actor-by-action decision.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A bank-setting delegate changes a permitted destination but cannot release a payout; a payout delegate cannot substitute their own destination.

checks.journey: Delegate disputes without granting every financial action
checks.normal_flow: Identify the transaction and side of the case, collect permitted evidence, track deadlines and explain outcomes.
checks.exceptions: Pending activity, duplicate complaint, withdrawal, prior refund or staff departure require ownership and careful access.
checks.issuing_handoff: Cardholder complaints and delegated card-account servicing stay within assigned activity.
checks.merchant_handoff: Submitting evidence, accepting a claim and issuing a refund need separately defined authority.
checks.etail_gap: The ninety-row case journeys need an explicit role split and replacement owner when a delegate leaves.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A case worker can supply evidence but cannot refund or withdraw another party's case; the authorized decision maker can act with a recorded reason.

checks.journey: Change contact details and preserve security communications
checks.normal_flow: Distinguish personal contact from business billing/operational contact; verify sensitive changes and show who receives which notices.
checks.exceptions: Lost contact, shared inbox, departed staff or an unauthorized change requires recovery and a retained accountable owner.
checks.issuing_handoff: Card alerts and application updates follow the right participant.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant dispute and bank-change messages must not be stranded in an old employee inbox.
checks.etail_gap: Add lost-contact and departure recovery, including mandatory communications; marketing preferences are insufficient.
checks.acceptance_scenario: An administrator leaves after changing job email; operational cases transfer without exposing private cardholder notices to their replacement.

checks.journey: Handle a death notification and subsequent authority review
checks.normal_flow: Accept a notification, identify the affected relationship and route an authority-reviewed closure or continuity case.
checks.exceptions: Being a relative, cardholder or manager must not automatically disclose records or transfer responsibility.
checks.issuing_handoff: Review additional cards, pending requests, existing obligations and permitted continuity.
checks.merchant_handoff: Review a deceased business representative separately from the surviving merchant business.
checks.etail_gap: No explicit bereavement journey in the frozen catalog; Etail needs a product decision and specialist evidence process.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A relative reports a death and receives an acknowledgement, but private records and account control wait for verified appropriate authority.

checks.journey: Support incapacity without automatic caretaker access
checks.normal_flow: Offer an assistance route, establish the permitted representative and record the scope and duration of support.
checks.exceptions: Ordinary help, third-party discussion and legal representation must not be treated as equivalent.
checks.issuing_handoff: Card control and responsibility changes need their own decisions.
checks.merchant_handoff: Business continuity must identify the proper representative without granting unrelated personal access.
checks.etail_gap: UK support is documented; a matching US and Etail authority/evidence journey remains undecided.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A caretaker asks for access; support can collect the request without granting spending, viewing history or changing bank details.

checks.journey: Review supervised access as circumstances change
checks.normal_flow: Explain funding, visibility and guardian authority; review access when guardianship or participant eligibility changes.
checks.exceptions: A birthday, invitation, new role or changed guardian must not automatically create borrowing, Seller ownership or private-history access.
checks.issuing_handoff: Existing cards and balances require an explicit permitted transition.
checks.merchant_handoff: Minor-associated commerce remains with the approved adult merchant.
checks.etail_gap: The Amex young-holder example does not establish Etail's guardian-funded product or adulthood/guardian-change transition; no exact frozen row covers this.
checks.acceptance_scenario: A supervised participant reaches a review milestone; they retain only permitted funded access until a separately approved adult product transition.

checks.journey: Close an account while completing remaining work
checks.normal_flow: Explain closure eligibility, stop new activity, resolve or retain remaining cases and confirm the resulting access to history.
checks.exceptions: Unpaid obligations, holds, pending refunds/payouts, disputes, disputed authority and earned benefits require an explicit plan.
checks.issuing_handoff: Card cancellation, account closure and membership cancellation are different outcomes.
checks.merchant_handoff: Merchant closure must preserve final settlement, dispute and statement responsibilities.
checks.etail_gap: Card cancellation is only a partial mapping; the frozen catalog lacks full ordinary account closure and residual-work coverage.
checks.acceptance_scenario: Request closure with an unpaid obligation and pending refund; new spending stops, closure status stays truthful and authorized follow-up remains possible.
